name: Solar Car Interior
description: A warm, materially-grounded color theme sampled directly from the interior cabin of the world's cheapest solar car (YouTube video: 'this is the worlds cheapest SOLAR CAR', timestamp 5:49/10:03). Colors were extracted via pixel sampling of the tan leather seats, bronze door armrest, cream trim, and cargo net accents, then expanded into full tonal scales for production UI use.

source.reference: YouTube: 'this is the worlds cheapest SOLAR CAR' (timestamp 5:49 / 10:03)
source.method: Pixel-sampled via cropped region analysis (median/mode filtering to avoid stitching, shadow, and specular-highlight outliers), then expanded into 11-step tonal ramps using fixed HSL lightness curves at the sampled hue/saturation.
source.note: Base swatch values are the true sampled pixel colors from the cabin material. All other steps in each scale are mathematically derived tints/shades for interface use, not independently sampled.

saddleTan.description: Main seat leather — warm caramel/saddle tan, the dominant color of the cabin.
saddleTan.sampledFrom: Seat backrest & cushion leather (broad median sample)

warmGreige.description: Door panel & seat bolster leather — muted warm taupe-grey, used for supporting surfaces and structure.
warmGreige.sampledFrom: Outer seat bolster + upper door panel (broad median sample)

metalBronze.description: Door armrest / grab-handle finish — soft metallic bronze-taupe. Use for primary interactive accents, icons, and highlighted UI elements.
metalBronze.sampledFrom: Armrest bar, lit upper surface (warm-filtered median sample)

ivoryCream.description: Cushion piping & seat rim trim — light warm ivory. Use for light backgrounds, cards, and surfaces.

charcoalNet.description: Cargo net mesh below the armrest — dark warm charcoal. Use for text, dark surfaces, and high-contrast elements.

rustTerracotta.description: Cargo net binding rope — muted burnt terracotta/rust. Use sparingly for badges, alerts-as-brand, or secondary CTAs — this is the only genuinely 'warm/colorful' accent in the cabin.
rustTerracotta.sampledFrom: Orange-red rope trim along top edge of cargo net

typography.note: Serif heading pairing chosen to echo the car's warm, tailored/leather-craft materiality; sans-serif body for clean UI legibility.

radii.note: Slightly rounded, soft corners to echo the seat's padded bolster curves.

usage.guidance: Lead with saddleTan + ivoryCream for warmth and approachability; use metalBronze for interactive accents (buttons, links, icons); reserve rustTerracotta for a single high-signal moment per screen (badge, alert-as-brand, key CTA) since it's the cabin's only true colorful accent; charcoalNet carries all body text and dark-mode surfaces.
